Meta.title: Che Fame — Modern Italian Restaurant in Vienna
Meta.description: Che Fame: pasta, pizza, antipasti and dolci in Vienna. Real dishes, a filterable menu, no fine dining.

Home.headline: Hungry? Perfetto.
Home.subtitle: Pasta, pizza, antipasti, dolci — right in Vienna-Margareten. Come hungry, we'll take care of the rest.

tavola.title: One table, everything on it.
tavola.body: That's what an evening here looks like: pasta, pizza, a glass of wine, lemon, basil — and decidedly too much bread.

fattoInCasa.title: Fatto in casa.
fattoInCasa.body: Pomodoro, basilico, limone, peperoncino — the four ingredients that show up in almost everything we make.

prenotaCta.title: So — convinced?
prenotaCta.body: Honestly: reading has never filled anyone up. Come and see for yourself — ideally hungry. Fridays and Saturdays tend to go first.

Cucina.metaDescription: The full Che Fame menu: pasta, pizza, antipasti, dolci — filterable by category, vegetarian and vegan.
Cucina.title: La Cucina
Cucina.subtitle: Tutto, Pasta, Pizza, Antipasti or Dolci — and vegetarian or vegan, if that's what you need.

carpaccio-manzo.name: Carpaccio di Manzo
carpaccio-manzo.description: Thinly sliced beef fillet, parmesan, rocket, lemon

pappardelle-ragu.name: Pappardelle al Ragù
pappardelle-ragu.description: Wide ribbon pasta, beef ragù, pecorino
